import collections
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys
out = pathlib.Path('/workspace/out/I-AP-04-R1-R3')
expected = [
    'src/tools/video-editor/components/AgentChat/AgentChat.test.tsx',
    'src/tools/video-editor/components/AgentChat/AgentChat.hosted.test.tsx',
    'src/tools/video-editor/components/AgentChat/AgentChat.projectContract.test.tsx',
    'src/tools/video-editor/components/AgentChat/NewChatMenu.test.tsx',
    'src/tools/video-editor/components/AgentChat/AgentChatMenu.test.tsx',
    'src/tools/video-editor/data/shotCompositionProjection.test.ts',
]
def clean(value):
    return re.sub(r'[\t\r\n]+', ' ', str(value))
try:
    data = json.loads((out / 'vitest.json').read_text())
    rows = []
    files = set()
    for suite in data.get('testResults', []):
        source = suite.get('name', '')
        file_name = next((item for item in expected if source.endswith(item)), source)
        for case in suite.get('assertionResults', []):
            full_name = case.get('fullName') or case.get('title') or ''
            status = case.get('status', 'unknown')
            rows.append((file_name, full_name, status))
            files.add(file_name)
    rows.sort()
    with (out / 'selected-case-inventory.tsv').open('w') as handle:
        handle.write('case_id\tfile\tstatus\n')
        for file_name, full_name, status in rows:
            handle.write(f'{clean(file_name)}::{clean(full_name)}\t{clean(file_name)}\t{clean(status)}\n')
    counts = collections.Counter(status for _, _, status in rows)
    missing = [item for item in expected if item not in files]
    nonpassing = [row for row in rows if row[2] != 'passed']
    success = data.get('success') is True
    valid = bool(rows) and not missing and not nonpassing and success
    with (out / 'selection-audit.txt').open('w') as handle:
        handle.write(f'requested_files={len(expected)}\nfiles_with_cases={len(files)}\ncollected_cases={len(rows)}\n')
        for status, count in sorted(counts.items()):
            handle.write(f'outcome_{clean(status)}={count}\n')
        handle.write('missing_files=' + (','.join(missing) if missing else 'none') + '\n')
        handle.write(f'nonpassing_cases={len(nonpassing)}\nvitest_success={success}\naudit_pass={valid}\n')
    sys.exit(0 if valid else 1)
except Exception as exc:
    (out / 'selection-audit.txt').write_text(f'audit_error={exc!r}\n')
    sys.exit(1)
PYTHON
audit_exit=$?
